basic_info.description:
This unit located in a duplex offers two distinct 3 bedroom 1 bath units with high ceilings. The newly renovated unit is VACANT and move-in ready, featuring refinished floors, fresh interior paint, newly painted cabinets with granite counters, updated hardware including lighting, locks and door knobs. The property also boasts new modern exterior paint, large garage with potential driveway parking, storage, laundry area, and a spacious level yard, a rare combination of comfort and convenience. This is your chance to lease this centrally located property .Do not miss out!

Owner pays for water renter pays for gas and electric. 12 month lease.
